feature_descriptions.Flow Duration: Duration of the bidirectional network flow in microseconds
feature_descriptions.Total Fwd Packet: Total number of packets transmitted in forward direction (source to dest)
feature_descriptions.Total Bwd packets: Total number of packets transmitted in backward direction (dest to source)
feature_descriptions.Total Length of Fwd Packet: Total payload bytes in forward direction
feature_descriptions.Total Length of Bwd Packet: Total payload bytes in backward direction
feature_descriptions.Fwd Packet Length Mean: Mean size of packets in forward direction
feature_descriptions.Bwd Packet Length Mean: Mean size of packets in backward direction
feature_descriptions.Flow Bytes/s: Data throughput rate in bytes per second
feature_descriptions.Flow Packets/s: Packet throughput rate in packets per second
feature_descriptions.Flow IAT Mean: Mean inter-arrival time between consecutive packets in microseconds
feature_descriptions.Flow IAT Std: Standard deviation of inter-arrival time between packets
feature_descriptions.SYN Flag Count: Number of packets with SYN flag set (connection establishment / SYN scan)
feature_descriptions.RST Flag Count: Number of packets with RST flag set (connection reset / scan probe)
feature_descriptions.PSH Flag Count: Number of packets with PSH flag set (push data buffer immediately)
feature_descriptions.ACK Flag Count: Number of packets with ACK flag set (acknowledgement)
feature_descriptions.FWD Init Win Bytes: Initial TCP window advertisement size in forward direction
feature_descriptions.Bwd Init Win Bytes: Initial TCP window advertisement size in backward direction
feature_descriptions.Average Packet Size: Overall average packet size in bytes across flow
feature_descriptions.Active Mean: Mean time flow was active before becoming idle
feature_descriptions.Idle Mean: Mean time flow was idle before becoming active
feature_descriptions.Dst Port: Destination port representing target network service
